$comment: Corrections to the vendored xychart.jsonschema.json (foundation-sdk v0.0.20). Sources are Grafana's CUE at the tag in `grafana`. See src/spec/overlay.ts.

value.description: The matcher options. This is specific to the matcher implementation: a field name for byName, a frame index for byIndex.

patches.why: The CUE says `options?: _`; the byName field matcher takes a string and the byIndex frame matcher a number, which is what Grafana writes for every manually mapped series.
